title: Field: Request to Shut In Pressure District 7

lines.text: IC, this is Supervisor Oyelowo. Both stations are on mechanical pilots, but PR-7B still reads 18 in. w.c. and we have high-flame calls on Canal Street. I have techs at Valve 21 and Valve 22. Do we shut in Pressure District 7 now — 5,120 customers at 12 degrees, two nursing homes — or hold on local control and watch the recorders?

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This is the critical life-safety decision point. The IC must authorize the shutdown based on field evidence. Watch for hesitation or attempts to validate via SCADA.

voiceLines.text: IC, this is Supervisor Oyelowo. All field verification is complete. RS-21 and RS-22 are confirmed at thirteen point two inches water column on calibrated field gauges. PR-7B is at fifteen point four inches water column and still rising. The pilot regulators are manually locked in mechanical mode and holding pressure. We have two independent field confirmations. The district is now in local control. I am requesting immediate authorization to shut in Pressure District Seven. This is not a drill. We have a resident on Canal Street who says they saw a flash. The situation is deteriorating. I need a decision now.

voiceLines.speaker: Field Supervisor Oyelowo
voiceLines.text: GCM, I’m sending a paper trip sheet for manual isolation authorization. Confirm receipt and action.
